csv.name: 100% Pure Creatine Monohydrate Capsules
csv.suggested_use: Recommended dosage: Take 4 capsules with plenty of liquid (300 ml); preferably before and after an intensive workout. On non-training days take 4 capsules with plenty of liquid (300 ml) first thing in the morning and again before bed time. Advice: To achieve a positive effect 3 g of creatine should be consumed per day. Once opened; use up quickly.

directions.notes: Recommended dosage: Take 4 capsules with plenty of liquid (300 ml), preferably before and after an intensive workout. On non-training days take 4 capsules with plenty of liquid (300 ml) first thing in the morning and again before bed time.
Advice: To achieve a positive effect 3 g of creatine should be consumed per day.

csv.name: Alphagen Candy Melon
csv.suggested_use: Recommended use: As a dietary supplement; mix 1 rounded scoop (15.3g) with 8-12oz water (depending on flavor preference) and consume 15-20 minutes pre-workout.
